{{Infobox |eng = Driftwood |source = [[Tools#Fishing Poles|Fishing Pole]] • [[Crab Pot]] • [[Fish Pond]] • [[Animals#Cat or Dog|Cat]] • [[Animals#Cat or Dog|Dog]] |xp = * Fishing Pole: 3 [[Fishing#Experience Points|Fishing XP]] * Crab Pot: 5 [[Fishing#Experience Points|Fishing XP]] * Fish Pond: 10 [[Fishing#Experience Points|Fishing XP]] |sellprice = 0 |quality = false |season = All }} '''Driftwood''' is a type of [[trash]] that can be caught when fishing during all seasons, in any location, using either a [[Tools#Fishing Poles|Fishing Pole]] or a [[Crab Pot]]. Also, any crab pot fish may produce Driftwood when placed in a [[Fish Pond]]. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat or dog with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. Driftwood may be [[Recycling Machine|recycled]] into [[Wood]] or [[Coal]], or [[Wood Chipper|chipped]] into [[Wood]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |dislike=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Leo,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus |like=Leah }} ==Recycling== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Item !Equipment !Product !Recycling Time |- |{{Name|Driftwood}} |{{Name|Recycling Machine}} |1-3 {{Name|Wood|75%|class=inline}} or
1-3 {{Name|Coal|25%|class=inline}} |{{duration|60 mins (1 hour)}} |- |{{Name|Driftwood}} |{{Name|Wood Chipper}} |5-10 {{Name|Wood|100%|class=inline}} |{{duration|180 mins (3 hours)}} |} ==Bundles== Driftwood is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Recipes== Driftwood is not used in any recipes. ==Tailoring== Driftwood is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt232|link=Tailoring{{!}}Trash Can Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a brown dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the orange dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]]. ==Quests== Three Driftwood may be requested by several fish in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]]. During the special order quest [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Community Cleanup]] the player is tasked with gathering 20 trash items (except Joja Cola). ==History== {{History|1.4|Can now be processed in the Wood Chipper.
